focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需紧急核查CBAM申报数据
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。近期欧盟委员会加强了对进口商季度报告的审查，中国钢铁、铝、化肥等行业出口企业面临数据合规压力。企业需确保隐含碳排放数据可追溯、可验证，否则可能被欧盟进口商转嫁风险或失去订单。建议尽快建立产品碳足迹核算体系，并与欧盟客户确认申报责任分配。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.09.29
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Verify Emissions Data
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with definitive taxation starting in 2027. The European Commission has recently intensified scrutiny of importers' quarterly reports, putting Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, and fertiliser sectors under compliance pressure. Companies must ensure embedded emissions data is traceable and verifiable, or risk shifting liability to EU importers and losing orders. Establishing a product carbon footprint system and clarifying reporting responsibilities with EU clients is imperative.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭首例承认中国法院商事判决，跨境执行路径进一步拓宽
case.summary: 新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）近期依据《选择法院协议公约》及新中双边备忘录，承认并执行了一起中国法院作出的商事金钱判决。该案涉及中资企业与新加坡公司的货物买卖纠纷，SICC认定中国法院管辖协议有效且程序正当。此案表明，在存在排他性管辖协议的情况下，中国判决在普通法系的承认路径更加清晰。出海企业可在合同中优先约定SICC或中国法院管辖，并保留相关证据。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭 · 2026.09
case.title_en: SICC Recognises Chinese Commercial Judgment for First Time, Broadening Cross-Border Enforcement
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) has recently recognised and enforced a monetary commercial judgment from a Chinese court under the Hague Choice of Court Convention and the China-Singapore bilateral memorandum. The case involved a sale of goods dispute between a Chinese enterprise and a Singaporean company, with the SICC upholding the validity of the Chinese court's jurisdiction agreement and due process. This indicates a clearer recognition pathway for Chinese judgments in common law jurisdictions where exclusive jurisdiction agreements exist. Outbound firms should consider designating SICC or Chinese courts in contracts and preserve relevant evidence.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境数据流动“白名单”机制，便利企业合规传输个人信息
policy.summary: 广东省与香港、澳门相关部门近期联合发布大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”制度，允许符合条件的企业在金融、医疗、贸易等领域向港澳传输个人信息，免于逐笔申报。该机制要求企业通过安全评估并加入行业自律公约。此举旨在降低合规成本，促进大湾区一体化。企业应尽快评估自身数据场景，申请纳入白名单，并完善内部数据保护政策。
policy.source: 来源：广东省政务服务数据管理局 · 2026.09
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches Cross-Border Data Flow 'Whitelist' to Facilitate Compliant Personal Information Transfers
policy.summary_en: Authorities in Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao have jointly introduced a cross-border data flow 'whitelist' for the Greater Bay Area, permitting eligible enterprises in finance, healthcare, and trade to transfer personal information to Hong Kong and Macao without case-by-case filings. The mechanism requires companies to pass a security assessment and join industry self-regulatory pacts. This aims to reduce compliance costs and promote regional integration. Companies should assess their data scenarios, apply for whitelist inclusion, and enhance internal data protection policies.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Government Services and Data Management Bureau · 2026.09

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中国科技企业需重构跨境架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期拟扩大对外投资审查范围，将人工智能、量子计算、先进半导体等领域纳入禁止或申报交易。中国科技企业通过离岸架构进行海外融资或技术合作可能触发合规风险。建议企业立即梳理现有投资路径，评估是否涉及敏感技术，并考虑调整交易结构或申请豁免。同时，应加强内部合规培训，避免因违规导致制裁或处罚。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law · 2026.09.29
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Expanded US Outbound Investment Screening Requires Chinese Tech Firms to Restructure Cross-Border Frameworks
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US is poised to expand outbound investment screening to cover AI, quantum computing, and advanced semiconductors, with prohibited or notifiable transactions. Chinese tech firms using offshore structures for overseas financing or tech cooperation may face compliance risks. Companies should immediately map existing investment paths, assess exposure to sensitive technologies, and consider adjusting deal structures or seeking exemptions. Internal compliance training should be strengthened to avoid sanctions or penalties for violations.
